idea: Week three, from the story bank: written from the source, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: Between March 2021 and March 2025 India's installed renewable capacity, large hydro included, grew from 142,013 MW to 220,096 MW. Rajasthan added 23,324 MW of the 78,084 MW increase: 30%. Its share of India's capacity rose in each of the four years, from 7.6% to 15.5%.

This is installed capacity, not electricity generated. State totals, not per person. Ladakh sits inside Jammu and Kashmir's 2021 figure, so the two are not compared on the map. Given by MNRE in a Lok Sabha answer of 4 February 2026.
source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, answer to Lok Sabha Unstarred Question 768, 4 February 2026 (Annexure-I): cumulative installed renewable energy capacity of each state and union territory, in megawatts, as on 31 March 2021 and 31 March 2025. Large hydro is included. Each share is of the all-India total printed in the same table.
